facts.fact: Sunni, seven, is a sick child in Ranu; her mother is unnamed. Other named sick: Hira the weaver (blue lip), Bholu's mother, old Lalli, the Dev boy and his father, Kamla's two small children.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a named child who dies and triage choices on the page.

facts.fact: A course of redbark is a pinch in hot walnut-leaf tea morning and night for three days; a packet is two courses (three if stretched). Nimmi can brew six cups at a time, so doses go out in waves.
facts.why: needed to make the eighteen-courses arithmetic and the delay that kills Sunni concrete.

facts.fact: The badge under Kiran's pillow is brass gone brown, palm-wide, stamped with the queen's goat head, with a small dent in the rim.
facts.why: needed to describe clue C16 on the page.

facts.fact: Meera now knows Kiran holds a warden's badge and withholds it from Rohan as a free silence; she does not yet know whose it is.
facts.why: needed for the beat and the chapter's dramatic irony.

facts.fact: Sunni rings Badami's dented bell, which Meera lends her; Sunni dies holding it.
facts.why: needed to make Sunni liked before the threat.
